title: Through The Fire And Flames
lyrics:
[00:38.80]On a cold winter morning
[00:40.60]In the time before the light
[00:43.00]In flames of Death's eternal reign
[00:45.52]We ride towards the fight
[00:48.40]When the darkness has fallen down
[00:50.32]And the times are tough, alright
[00:52.59]The sound of evil laughter falls
[00:55.16]Around the world tonight
[00:57.94]Fighting hard, fighting on for the steel
[00:59.88]Through the wastelands evermore
[01:02.19]The scattered souls will feel the hell
[01:04.70]Bodies wasted on the shores
[01:06.74]On the blackest plains in hell's domain
[01:09.51]We watch them as they go
[01:11.84]In fire and pain, now once again
[01:14.25]We know
[01:16.04]So now, we fly ever free, we're free before the thunderstorm
[01:21.75]On towards the wilderness, our quest carries on
[01:26.45]Far beyond the sundown, far beyond the moonlight
[01:31.26]Deep inside our hearts and all our souls
[01:35.19]So far away, we wait for the day
[01:40.22]For the lives, all so wasted and gone
[01:44.84]We feel the pain of a lifetime lost in a thousand days
[01:49.94]Through the fire and the flames, we carry on
[02:14.79]As the red day is dawning
[02:16.65]And the lightning cracks the sky
[02:19.00]They'll raise their hands to the heavens above
[02:21.51]With resentment in their eyes
[02:24.39]Running back through the mid-morning light
[02:26.26]There's a burning in my heart
[02:28.60]We're banished from a time in a fallen land
[02:31.07]To a life beyond the stars
[02:33.17]In your darkest dreams, see to believe
[02:35.94]Our destiny this time
[02:38.25]And endlessly we'll all be free
[02:40.68]Tonight
[02:42.49]And on the wings of a dream, so far beyond reality
[02:48.10]All alone in desperation, now the time has gone
[02:52.89]Lost inside you'll never find, lost within my own mind
[02:57.69]Day after day, this misery must go on
[03:01.64]So far away, we wait for the day
[03:06.60]For the lives, all so wasted and gone
[03:11.19]We feel the pain of a lifetime lost in a thousand days
[03:16.41]Through the fire and the flames, we carry on
[03:41.53]Whoa-oh, oh, whoa-oh, oh, whoa-oh, oh-oh-oh
[03:51.04]Whoa-oh, oh, whoa-oh, oh, whoa-oh, oh-oh-oh
[06:04.74]Now, here we stand with their blood on our hands (Blood on our hands)
[06:09.55]We fought so hard now, can we understand? (Can we understand?)
[06:14.37]I'll break the seal of this curse if I possibly can
[06:19.73]For freedom of every man
[06:23.88]So far away, we wait for the day
[06:29.00]For the lives, all so wasted and gone
[06:33.54]We feel the pain of a lifetime lost in a thousand days
[06:38.74]Through the fire and the flames, we carry on
